captions.detailed: A classic casino slot machine featuring a tall, dark red rectangular cabinet. On the right side of the cabinet, there is a mounted pull handle consisting of a dark grey base, a metallic silver lever, and a black spherical knob. A shallow silver coin tray projects from the lower front of the cabinet. The lever is designed to rotate forward and backward in a realistic pulling motion.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a casino slot machine with a tall, dark red cabinet, a front-mounted coin tray, and an interactive pull handle on the right side. The handle should be mounted on a dark grey base, with a silver lever and a black sphere on top, configured with a revolute joint to swing back and forth.
captions.factory: Construct the main cabinet using a large Box primitive, and hollow out a top recess using a boolean subtraction. Create the coin tray at the lower front using a thin Box and additional hollow-out cuts. For the right-side handle, instantiate a small rectangular mounting block, a cylindrical lever arm, and a Sphere for the knob. Define a revolute joint connecting the handle components to the cabinet block to enable rotational motion.
